slides.title: Practical workflow: Module 4
slides.subtitle: A practical note for Open-Source AI Tools for Security, Audit, and DevOps

slides.title: The problem
slides.body: AI-assisted projects still need security scanning, audit trails, incident investigation, and deployment discipline.

slides.title: Control 1
slides.body: Review generated code like any other production change.

slides.title: Control 2
slides.body: Make scanners available before the agent asks for deployment.

slides.title: Control 3
slides.body: Record what changed, which tools ran, and which checks passed.
